item.title: SeL4 安全证明现已在 AArch64 上完成
item.description:
📝 2026 年 8 月 21 日，seL4 安全证明现已在 AArch64 上完成 在完成功能正确性和完整性证明后，Proofcraft 现已建立了 seL4 在 AArch64 上强制执行机密性的证明，提供了正式的数学证明，证明内核可防止在 seL4 上运行的应用程序在未经授权的情况下学习信息。感谢 NCSC 的持续支持，这一里程碑完成了 AArch64 上的 seL4 实现代码强制执行其上运行的应用程序的安全隔离的正式证明（在此处列出的假设下）。这种隔离可以防止对非关键应用程序的攻击传播到关键应用程序并危害它们。
🔤 Original: SeL4 security proofs now complete on AArch64
🔗 Read more: https://proofcraft.systems/news-2026/#2026-08-21

item.title: 人类候选人面临生硬的金钱问题
问 HN：为什么企业失败似乎总是惩罚错误的人？
item.description:
📝 She's moved from IC to managing over 30 people and barely manages to use vacation days because she's always working. He moved into this role from failing elsewhere, leaving the chaos there behind him, and over the past two years, now has caused yet another disaster in this new role. This used to be a thing I've heard over and over again from friends at Google, but it really seems to be very consistent thing elsewhere, too.
🔤 Original: Ask HN: Why do corporate failures always seem to punish the wrong people?
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49418675
